short_description:
GTA 6 has a nod to the TV series Dexter: a light-blue waterfront building with a spiral staircase on Washington Island, east of Vice City. The door stays locked, and a look-alike of Dexter's boat sits at a dock to the west. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

📍 Map Spot #23 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: Dexerto, The Click, TheGamer, GamesRadar.
